  • We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

  • Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

  • Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

  • Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

  • Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

  • Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

  • Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

  • One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We’re technology-driven, data-informed, and focused on hiring against business priorities and outcomes. Just as importantly, we’re team-first: collaborative, supportive, low-ego, and committed to building something meaningful together.

Building a legendary company should be fun.

About this role

As Preply continues to scale, Engineering remains at the core of our product, growth, and future. We're expanding technical hiring across complex domains and global tech hubs - and we're looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager - Tech to help us build a hiring engine that can match that ambition.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll directly manage a team of TA Partners with full reporting lines, while also personally owning complex engineering searches. You'll stay close to the craft, but your impact will go beyond individual roles: you'll help turn workforce plans into clear hiring priorities, translate those priorities into smart hiring strategies, and build the processes that allow us to hire exceptional talent with speed, quality, and focus.

You'll partner closely with TA Leadership, Engineering Directors, VPs, and our CTO to understand what the business needs, where the biggest hiring bets are, and how we should sequence work across domains and hubs. You'll own the full hiring rhythm: planning, sourcing strategy, pipeline health, calibration, weekly progress tracking, issue-spotting, and continuous improvement.

It's a great fit for someone who has already managed a tech recruitment function and team, and wants to grow within an environment that moves and scales fast, and holds a genuinely high quality bar.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the Engineering hiring engine end to end: understand and collaborate on workforce plans, clarify hiring priorities, translate them into hiring strategies, and make sure the team is set up to deliver against business needs.

  • Directly manage a team of TA Partners: full ownership of their performance, development, clear direction and priorities, coaching on search strategy and stakeholder management, and unblocking execution where needed.

  • Drive hiring outcomes across technical domains and hubs: take accountability for progress, quality, and delivery across Engineering hiring in our main hubs Barcelona, London and Kyiv, while personally owning a couple of complex and high-impact searches.

  • Build and optimize hiring processes: identify what slows us down, where quality drops, or where ownership is unclear - then improve the process so we can hire top talent in the most effective way.

  • Track progress through data: run a strong weekly hiring rhythm, using funnel data, pipeline quality, pass-through rates, time in stage, sourcing performance, and stakeholder feedback to understand what's working and what needs to change.

  • Lead calibration at scale: align a large and growing group of engineering interviewers and hiring managers on a consistent hiring bar, using structured calibration sessions, clear documentation, and ongoing reinforcement.

  • Flag risks early and solve them fast: spot blockers before they become bigger issues, bring clear recommendations, and work with TA, Engineering, and cross-functional partners to keep hiring moving.

  • Lead top-of-funnel strategy for Engineering: shape sourcing, talent mapping, talent intelligence, and employer branding in partnership with Marketing and Employer Brand. Build consistent, high-quality pipelines for priority roles.

  • Raise the hiring bar: define ideal candidate profiles, sharpen scorecards, lead calibration, and improve consistency in how we evaluate candidates across a large and growing group of engineering interviewers and hiring teams.

  • Elevate TA craft across the team: raise standards for candidate experience, sourcing quality, stakeholder management, data literacy, and business understanding.

What you'll need to succeed

  • Expert-level engineering recruiting craft. You run complex technical searches end to end, care deeply about candidate experience, consistently deliver strong outcomes on hard-to-fill roles - and coach your team to reach the same level of excellence

  • Strong in-house recruiting experience. You've partnered closely with Engineering Directors, VPs, CTOs, or similarly senior technical stakeholders and earned their trust.

  • Experience turning workforce plans into hiring strategies. You take business priorities and headcount plans and translate them into clear, sequenced, actionable hiring plans with strong process and execution discipline: operating rhythms, weekly tracking, early risk flags, multiple tracks moving in parallel.

  • A track record of improving hiring systems at scale. You've raised pipeline quality, pass-through rates, sourcing performance, or hiring predictability across teams or locations, including through AI and technology.

  • Experience leading calibration and quality across a large interviewer group. You've defined hiring bars and helped hiring teams make better, more consistent decisions.

  • Proven people management experience in a high-growth, fast scaling environment. A strong manager who stays close to the craft. You take pride in excellent recruiting work and want to remain hands-on.

  • Strong influence and communication skills. You create clarity, challenge thoughtfully, and build trust with senior stakeholders and peers.

  • A team-first, low-ego approach. Collaborative, generous with knowledge, and motivated by raising the bar for Engineering hiring and the TA function overall.

  • Fluency in English and readiness to work from Barcelona, London, or Kyiv.

Our Principles

  • Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

  • We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

  • Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

  • Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

  • Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

  • Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

  • Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

  • Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

  • One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Our analytics platform supports teams across Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI. The quality, discoverability, and accessibility of our data directly impact how quickly teams can make confident decisions.

As a Junior Analytics Engineer, you’ll own one of the most widely used pieces of our analytics ecosystem: Looker. You’ll help ensure that more than 900 people across Preply can easily find, understand, and trust the data they use every day. This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one, combining analytics engineering, data governance, documentation, and continuous improvement of our self-service analytics platform.

Please note: This role is open to candidates based in Ukraine. You can work from our Kyiv hub or remotely from anywhere in Ukraine.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own Looker licensing — Manage the license granting process, be the point of contact with Looker’s service, stay up-to-date with new Looker upgrades, identify unused licenses and periodically revoke them,

  • Create and maintain documentation — produce high-quality technical documentation, user guides, and onboarding materials that help teams work confidently with data.

  • Partner with stakeholders across the business — be the go-to person for Looker, helping teams find, understand, and use data effectively.

  • An analytical mindset — you enjoy understanding what data means, not just retrieving it.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity and learning.

  • English proficiency at B2 level or above.

  • Make feedback learners actually act on. The core job of Insights is to help learners improve. That means ruthless prioritization of what feedback to show, when, and how - not showing everything the models can detect.

  • Connect insights to progress. Learners don't just want feedback on one lesson, they want to know they're getting better. You'll shape how per-lesson insights look, and structure how they ladder up into progress over time, working closely with the Progress squad.

  • Bring tutors into the loop. Insights work best when they strengthen the learner-tutor relationship. You'll design for both sides of the marketplace.

  • Drive reach. Maximize how many learners benefit from Insights by scaling to other languages.

  • Drive engagement. Maximize feature retention via useful & engaging design that makes users want to check their insights after every lesson..

  • Go into the data yourself. Pull your own analyses on how learners engage with feedback, what drives repeat usage, and where the experience is falling flat.

Must-haves

  • Consumer product craft. Substantial experience building consumer-facing, mobile-first products with frequent, habitual use. You have a keen eye for design and care about the details of a delightful experience.

  • Learner and tutor empathy. You are genuinely curious about the people using your product and bring that into every prioritization call.

  • Experimentation rigor. Solid grounding in A/B testing, experiment design, and how to read results without fooling yourself.

  • Strong communication. You can turn complex, ambiguous work into a clear point of view that drives decisions at the leadership level.

  • Bias for action. You balance conviction-building with quick, lean hypothesis testing - ship the MVP, learn, iterate.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can make fuzzy things measurable and drive alignment on what good looks like.

  • Experience with learning languages

Nice-to-haves

  • EdTech or learning science background (CEFR, assessment, feedback design)

  • Experience with unstructured data - text, audio, transcripts

You will have ownership of high-impact, well-scoped work — such as feature engineering, data pipelines, offline evaluation tooling, and experiment analysis — while receiving close mentorship from experienced ICs.

 - Drive engagement. Maximize feature retention via useful & engaging design that makes users want to check their insights after every lesson..

 - Go into the data yourself. Pull your own analyses on how learners engage with feedback, what drives repeat usage, and where the experience is falling flat.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - Consumer product craft. Substantial experience building consumer-facing, mobile-first products with frequent, habitual use. You have a keen eye for design and care about the details of a delightful experience.

 - GenAI / LLM product experience. You have shipped products built on LLMs or NLP at scale, and can discuss trade offs & approaches with the team - evals, hallucinations, quality variance, latency, cost - and how to design around them.

 - Learner and tutor empathy. You are genuinely curious about the people using your product and bring that into every prioritization call.

 - Deeply data-driven. You go into the data yourself, find the signal, and build a point of view from scratch. You do not wait to be handed an analysis.

 - Experimentation rigor. Solid grounding in A/B testing, experiment design, and how to read results without fooling yourself.

 - Strong communication. You can turn complex, ambiguous work into a clear point of view that drives decisions at the leadership level.

 - Bias for action. You balance conviction-building with quick, lean hypothesis testing - ship the MVP, learn, iterate.

 - Comfort with ambiguity. You can make fuzzy things measurable and drive alignment on what good looks like.

 - Experience with learning languages


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - EdTech or learning science background (CEFR, assessment, feedback design)

 - Experience with unstructured data - text, audio, transcripts

 - Experience with habit-forming products and behavioural psychology

 


OUR PRINCIPLES

 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

 - Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

 - Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

 - One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Martech
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

As a product team, our goal is to improve the life of our students and our tutors, drive amazing learning outcomes for our learners and enable our tutors to financially thrive through the platform. And we want to do this all while generating business value for Preply so we can help even more people! We strongly believe that we can't achieve business success without our students' and tutors' success.

Preply is a product led company. As part of the product team, you will have a direct impact on the company's growth and strategy with high visibility to our C-suite and leadership team. You will be empowered to operate independently with a dedicated cross functional team to build amazing products and take them from inception to launch to scale!

With great power comes great responsibility. Our product managers have true end-to-end accountability for their area with varied areas of responsibility such as: setting the long term vision and strategy for the squad, conceptualizing the product(s), driving the daily execution with the team, launching and analyzing the impact of your product on our customers.

What you'll be doing:

Preply is one of the largest advertisers in the Education Tech space. Our marketing operations span dozens of languages, thousands of creatives, and multiple acquisition channels. To keep growing at this scale, we need world-class products that take marketing channels to levels of performance impossible to reach manually.

As the Senior Product Manager for MarTech Scale, you'll own the products that scale Preply's marketing channels far beyond what manual effort allows - across Paid Search, SEO, AI Search, Display (Meta, TikTok, etc.), Affiliates, and the next wave of channels yet to emerge.

You'll partner with engineering, data, and marketing teams to build products that efficiently drive new subscribers to Preply at unprecedented scale.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Scale paid acquisition channels through Product

    • Own the SEM platform that posts and optimises millions of keywords - from discovery, through bidding, account structure, and ad copy generation. Push the team toward an always-on, data-driven automated scale of operations.

    • Build creative automation for Display channels - generating, tracking, testing and iterating on creatives, across dozens of languages and regions.

    • Build channel-management products for Display and Affiliates - automating bidding, account structure, partner onboarding, and reporting so the team can run dozens of campaigns and partners as one.

    • Partner with channel owners to identify the next leverage point - a new bidding model, account architecture, or feed strategy - and turn it into a Product.

    • Identify and build new acquisition channels (e.g., OpenAI Apps) before competitors do.

  • Power organic and AI Search with a limitless page-creation engine

    • Lead the product behind a step-change in SEO scale, with a system that takes keyword opportunities and produces high-quality pages, at scale.

    • Shape Preply's positioning in AI Search as discovery shifts from blue links to LLM answers - defining the content, structure, and signals that win on this new surface.

    • Continuously evolve the page-creation engine to stay ahead of evolving search behaviour, ranking systems, and AI search tools.

  • Make landing pages a conversion advantage

    • Own the Preply homepage, and the platform that powers bespoke landing pages across marketing channels. Deeply understand users’ intents from different marketing channels and match that to their landing experience.

    • Partner with the broader Growth Tribe to optimize the top of the funnel end-to-end - carrying marketing intent across the full conversion journey, not just the landing page.

    • Run a fast cycle of hypothesis, experiment, learning across geographies, audiences, and channels.

  • Make Preply Marketing AI-native

    • Make AI a first-class building block in the platforms you ship. From keyword and ad copy generation, to page creation, to creative automation - AI is the engine that makes scale possible. Architect for it from day one rather than retrofitting it later.

    • Be the standard-bearer for AI inside the Marketing org - proactively identifying where AI compounds marketer output and be hands-on building solutions.

    • Build the platform and guardrails that let every marketer at Preply operate with AI safely and effectively in their daily work.

    • Stay close to the frontier of AI capabilities, and translate what's possible into what's worth shipping.

Leadership & Ways of Working:

  • Lead with vision: Stay at the forefront of marketing technology, growth, and AI innovation. Anticipate industry shifts - from how AI is reshaping search behaviour to emerging acquisition surfaces - and translate them into a clear, long-term MarTech Scale strategy for Preply.

  • Be a domain authority: Inspire your squad and cross-functional partners by articulating a bold vision for how Tech can scale marketing channels far beyond what's possible today.

  • Go deep into the system: Own the platform at the depth of an engineer. Query the tables yourself, read the data pipelines, design the architecture alongside the team. Open the marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta, GSC) and see the performance with your own eyes. The best decisions in MarTech come from PMs who understand the system as well as the people building it.

  • Own end-to-end outcomes: Take full ownership of the product lifecycle - from defining platform requirements and architectural choices to driving execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.

  • Be biased for action: Balance strategy and developing conviction with quick and lean hypothesis testing to launch MVPs and iterate based on results. Open the marketing platforms and see the performance with your own eyes.

  • Make decisions through data: Use data to evaluate the impact of platform changes on marketing efficiency, scale, and growth.

  • Be a cross-functional force multiplier: Partner deeply with Marketing, Data, and Engineering teams - sharing ownership of KPIs and building trust through transparency and collaboration. Foster a culture where automation and AI enable every marketer at Preply to operate at their full potential.

What you need to succeed:

  • At least five years of hands-on technical experience in Performance Marketing channel management for a highly-trafficked consumer website OR experience as a product manager in marketing technology.

  • You have experience in MarTech, AdTech, or Analytics platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads APIs, SEO tooling, GTM, Segment, or internal data pipelines).

  • You have knowledge of SEO and how it is evolving in an AI-first world.

  • You have knowledge of App marketing.

  • You are willing to get your hands dirty, and work hands-on with Google Ads, Meta, etc.

  • You're a systems thinker who thrives on making complex ecosystems automated, measurable, and scalable.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem solving abilities.

  • You have experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver products to global markets.

  • You're a natural leader. You know how to influence people to get things done across any job function. People love working with you.

  • You balance strategy and execution - defining long-term vision while shipping incremental improvements quickly.

  • You're an excellent communicator, capable of aligning engineers, marketers, and executives around a shared vision.

 

Our Principles

  • Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

  • We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

  • Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

  • Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

  • Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

  • Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

  • Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

  • Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

  • One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

  • Conduct end-to-end due diligence across financial, commercial, legal, and operational dimensions, coordinating external advisors where needed

  • Project-manage cross-functional workstreams (Finance, Legal, Product, HR) throughout deal execution and integration planning

  • Develop board-ready strategic recommendations and executive presentations on M&A opportunities

  • Expert-level Excel (or equivalent) and financial modelling skills: you've built complex valuation models from scratch and can defend every assumption

  • A proven track record of working on acquisitions end-to-end, from deal origination through to close; post-merger integration experience is a plus

  • Strong P&L literacy and analytical rigour; ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills — you translate complex analyses into clear, executive-level narratives

  • Ideally with prior experience in EdTech, SaaS, or high-growth tech

Why you’ll love it at Preply:

  • An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

  • A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

  • A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

  • Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

  • Access to free mental health support platforms;

  • Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Meet the team!

Our team builds scalable, resilient products using Python/Django on the backend and React on the frontend, all with one goal in mind: creating a smooth, meaningful experience for our learners and tutors.

We're proudly tech-agnostic, great engineers come from all kinds of backgrounds. Whether you’ve worked with Java/Spring, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Scala/Play, PHP, or Go, you’ll feel right at home here. Python experience isn’t required.

We make decisions based on data and real user feedback: running A/B tests, shipping iteratively, and constantly improving. We also put a strong focus on observability, monitoring, and metrics, so we can keep our systems healthy and continue optimizing at scale.

At Preply, we ship 50–60 times per day, thanks to a solid CI/CD setup and a culture that values action over ceremony. As a fast-growing company, you’ll find a wide range of technical challenges (we even write about many of them on our Engineering Blog!), the kind of work that keeps you learning, stretching, and growing.

We’ve reached 90%+ adoption of AI coding tools across engineering, and we’re now moving towards more autonomous, AI-Augmented development at scale. At Preply, engineers have direct access to the best tools available, with the freedom to use them fully and experiment as they build.

You will work in a cross-functional team alongside Product Managers, Product Designers, UX Writers, Data Analysts, Engineering Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver meaningful outcomes for learners and tutors.   • Back-end Development: Develop and own backend features using Python/Django, supporting the creation of new backend services as well as design, create, and/or troubleshoot integrations with third-party vendors.;

  • UI Development: Develop and evolve frontend experiences in React/Typescript, contributing to experimentation frameworks and helping establish frontend engineering best practices;

  • Implementation & Ownership: Lead complex initiatives from discovery through deployment, taking ownership of solutions throughout their lifecycle and balancing immediate product needs with long-term sustainability;

  • Raising the Bar: Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, architectural reviews, and the adoption of best practices across frontend and backend development;

  • Data-Driven Product Development: Partner closely with Product, Data, and UX teammates to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and maximize customer value through experimentation and measurable outcomes;

  • System Design: Shape architectural direction for complex systems, making technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, maintainability, and developer productivity;

  • Prioritisation & Decision-Making: Navigate ambiguity, evaluate trade-offs, and align technical investments with business objectives and customer impact;

  • Technical Leadership: Influence technical direction beyond your immediate scope, collaborating with engineers, managers, and stakeholders to drive alignment and successful delivery;

  • Chasing Excellence: Continuously raise the quality bar through craftsmanship, curiosity, continuous learning, and a commitment to helping others grow.

What you need to succeed

  • Full-Stack Expertise: This is a backend-heavy full-stack role, with approximately 60% of the work focused on backend development and 40% on frontend development;

  • AI Expertise: Deep, hands-on expertise in Agentic AI. Able to redesign how the team builds software across the full SDLC, not just code generation. Builds reusable AI assets that your team can adopt, and delegates reasoning-heavy work while reserving judgment for architecture, business logic, and security. You set up the AI quality gates and you challenge existing engineering workflows and propose AI-based alternatives.

  • Scalable Systems & Architecture: Experience designing and evolving large-scale web applications, including well-designed APIs, distributed systems, high-volume data flows, and scalable architectural patterns. Ability to make sound technical trade-offs that balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability;

  • Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions, drive engineering best practices, and contribute to architectural direction within your team;

  • Product & Business Impact: Strong product mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable technical solutions, using experimentation, data, and customer insights to guide decisions;

  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Comfortable navigating ambiguity and independently solving complex technical and product challenges, while knowing when to engage others to maximize impact;

  • Ownership & Accountability: High level of self-organization, ownership, and responsibility, with a track record of driving initiatives from concept through delivery and measurable outcomes;

  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, design, and data functions. English level B2 or higher;

  • Engineering Excellence: Experience working in a cross functional team, contributing to code and design reviews, and helping raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and technical leadership;

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Preply is seeking a Senior GRC Analyst to join our Cybersecurity team and participate in one of the most business-critical functions in our fast-growing global company. This is an opportunity to shape and scale our governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) program.

You'll report to Director of Security and work closely with a small, high-impact Cybersecurity team. The role will be central to maintaining and expanding our risk management program, sustaining compliance with industry standards (especially SOC 2 Type 2), and building scalable governance processes to reduce identified risks.

You’ll work cross-functionally with Legal, Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, and company leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep risk and compliance expertise, thrives in ambiguity, and is energized by building secure, scalable systems that support business growth.

What you will be doing:

  • Maintain and continuously improve the risk management framework. Manage and continuously improve Preply's risk management framework, defining risk management approaches and overseeing the implementation of mitigation actions across the business.

  • Lead risk assessments. Run enterprise risk assessments, surfacing both technical and non-technical risks, and track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and other data-driven risk metrics to report to leadership.

  • Manage third-party risk. Maintain a third-party risk management program and perform periodic vendor reviews to ensure suppliers meet Preply's security bar.

  • Help shape governance and policy. Participate in developing and maintaining security, AI, and compliance policies in collaboration with Legal, Security, and Data teams, embedding governance checks into everyday business operations.

  • Drive SOC 2 and beyond. Support compliance initiatives for SOC 2 Type 2, with potential expansion to ISO 27001, ensuring controls are documented, tested, and audit-ready.

  • Support privacy initiatives. Contribute to data retention policies and guidelines for how different departments handle personal data.

  • Be the cross-functional bridge. Support coordination between Cybersecurity, Legal, and Engineering - translating regulatory requirements (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) into actionable policies, and supporting internal/external audits, policy reviews, and compliance syncs.

  • Champion security culture. Drive security awareness and compliance culture across the company.

  • Automate GRC operations. Identify opportunities to use AI tools to automate and streamline risk and compliance workflows (e.g. evidence collection, control monitoring, reporting).

What you need to succeed:

  • 5+ years in GRC, risk management, compliance, or cybersecurity - preferably in a tech or SaaS environment.

  • A flexible background, which could include:

    • Engineering or technical roles with exposure to platform risk/security.

    • Legal or compliance roles, ideally with a specialization in cybersecurity or privacy.

    • Hybrid profiles (e.g., lawyers with CISSP, or engineers with compliance experience).

  • A proven track record in:

    • SOC 2 implementation (must-have).

    • Experience with frameworks/standards such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, or similar

    • Experience with regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, EU AI Act, or similar.

    • Risk assessments and KRIs.

    • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of cloud security and modern SaaS risk landscapes.

  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical, business-friendly policies.

  • Effective communicator with experience in running cross-functional sessions.

  • Practical experience applying AI tools in day-to-day work.

  • Experience with GRC/compliance automation tooling is a plus.

Certifications (nice to have, not required): CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CIPM.

Why you’ll love it at Preply

  • An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

  • A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

  • A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

  • Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub;

  • Access to free mental health support platforms;

  • Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

  • The opportunity to shape the lives of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).

Our Principles

  • Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

  • We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

  • Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

  • Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

  • Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

  • Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

  • Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

  • Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

  • Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

  • One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.
